def solve(values, target):
    a = values.copy()
    buf = [0] * (len(a))
    width = 1
    while (width < len(a)):
        start = 0
        while (start < len(a)):
            mid = min((start + width), len(a))
            end = min(((start + width) + width), len(a))
            left = start
            right = mid
            out = start
            while (out < end):
                if ((left < mid) and ((right >= end) or (a[left] <= a[right]))):
                    buf[out] = a[left]
                    left = (left + 1)
                else:
                    buf[out] = a[right]
                    right = (right + 1)
                out = (out + 1)
            start = end
        a = buf.copy()
        width = (width * 2)
    return a

def solve(values, target):
    links = [0] * (len(values))
    i = 0
    while (i < len(values)):
        links[i] = (i + 1)
        i = (i + 1)
    if (len(values) > 0):
        links[(len(values) - 1)] = -1
    prev = -1
    cur = 0
    if (len(values) == 0):
        cur = -1
    while (cur != -1):
        nxt = links[cur]
        links[cur] = prev
        prev = cur
        cur = nxt
    out = [0] * (len(values))
    i = 0
    while (prev != -1):
        out[i] = values[prev]
        prev = links[prev]
        i = (i + 1)
    return out
